{{Top|leg}}
'''Quadrant G-80''' was a section of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was the location of a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] parking space. Shortly after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], freight [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nyreen Vollen]] parked her ship, ''[[Cornucopia]]'', there while her companions, the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Nulls]], tried to extract [[Niner Skirata|Niner]] and [[Darman Skirata]] from the planet.<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
